terra.problem: Saying gratitude is the first thing out of Paul adds an order the text does not give.
Leaving worry in oven mitts has no clear connection to the action being compared, so the joke does not pass the logic test.
The joke puts down the critics as people who only come for free crumbs.
Saying the baker has been reading the wrong kind of letter makes the baker the target of the joke.
The cookie comparison muddles the point about glory going to God and suggests the one baking the cookie deserves the credit, putting Papa in God's role.
The passage does not say Paul is proud of the Philippians. The explanation states that feeling as fact rather than marking it as Papa's own guess.
